title: Astra Theme Review
description: A documentation-led profile of Astra’s starter-template workflow, flexible site-building approach, and questions to answer before choosing it.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped, documentation-led Astra WordPress theme profile from KreativWP.
price: Check current plans on the official site
highlights: Starter Templates can import complete sites or individual pages
Templates can be used with the free theme and are documented as theme-independent from Starter Templates 2.0 onward
The product ecosystem supports several WordPress building workflows, so a lean initial configuration matters
bestFor: People who value a broad template ecosystem and want to define their preferred editor or page-builder workflow before committing.
researchScope: This profile cross-checks Astra’s official FAQ and the current WordPress.org listing. It evaluates documented capabilities and setup implications, not page-speed scores or support quality.
caveats: No controlled install, Core Web Vitals benchmark, or support interaction has been completed for this profile. Revisit it for a hands-on verdict once those tests are documented.
